generate_cpu_pyproject: run the script to generate CPU-only pyproject.toml files for Python 3.12 and 3.13
generate_gpu_pyproject: run the script to generate GPU CUDA pyproject.toml files for Python 3.12 and 3.13
customize_torch_versions: run the script with custom --torch-min-py312 and --torch-max-py312 args to set PyTorch version bounds
customize_macos_torch_versions: run the script with --torch-min-py312-macos and --torch-max-py312-macos args to set macOS PyTorch version bounds
output_to_directory: run the script with --output-dir to write generated pyproject.toml files to a custom directory
